caption_L1: This bar graph is titled Leading species groups in global aquaculture production in 2018 (in 1,000 metric tons). A categorical scale with Carps, barbels and other cyprinids on one end and  at the other can be seen on the y-axis, marked species group. There is a linear scale of range 0 to 30,000 on the x-axis, marked Production in thousand metric tons.
caption_L2L3: The largest group being produced in 2018 in global aquaculture was Carps, barbels and other cyprinids, with just under 30,000 metric tons. The production in all the other categories was much lower. The second category was Miscellaneous freshwater fish at just over 10,000 tons. The rest of the categories were all under 10,000 tons. The smallest groups included Scallops and pectens at 2,000 tons and Marine fishes not identified at 1,000 tons.
